_network_type: SNN autoencoder, recurrent LIF input transform
_architecture_summary: Same network as article-snn-dense (Linear+Lif x2 encoder, Linear+Lif -> Linear+LifIntegrator decoder). Mode 'recurrent' applies a stand-alone LIF integration to the encoded input BEFORE the SNN: v[t] = alpha v[t-1] + x[t] - s[t-1] V_th, s[t] = 1[v[t] >= V_th]. Not a learned LSNN layer; no adaptive threshold.
_preprocessing: Non-overlapping windows of 256 samples (32 ms @ 8 kHz). Z-score per window. Encoding then LIF integration (mode='recurrent') with the swept (V_th, alpha).
_total_runs_breakdown: 81 = 3 encodings x 3 V_th x 3 alpha x 3 repeats.
_dataset_config: 100 train, 30 val from FSDD (shuffled split). 30 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001 (weights), 0.0001 (R,C,V_th), batch size 1.
_comment: SNN-AE with stand-alone LIF input transform. 81 runs. ~45 min.
